items.title: Collabora CODE 命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可在CODE服务未运行时通过proxy.php注入OS命令远程执行代码，已在野利用
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级到26.4.303及以上；无法升级时先禁用CODE组件
items.repro_note: 在CODE服务停止或刚重启窗口请求proxy.php注入命令
items.impact_scope: Nextcloud文档服务，常暴露内网/公网
items.description: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server before 26.4.303 (richdocumentscode), a Nextcloud app, allows remote code execution, as exploited in the wild in September and October 2026, a different vulnerability than CVE-2025-66208. This is an OS command injection in proxy.php when the CODE server isn't running (e.g., the product was recently restarted). The vulnerability is not present in standalone Collabora Online servers; only this deployment with CODE Server is affected.

items.title: Samsung QA-Board OS命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可将恶意参数拼入OS命令，在部署QA-Board的服务器上远程执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁并升级；暂无法升级时限制QA-Board对外访问
items.repro_note: 向QA-Board可写参数注入shell元字符触发命令执行
items.impact_scope: 开源QA工具，多部署于内网
items.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Samsung Open Source QA-Board allows : OS Command Injection.
